shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\nFILES\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.*'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\nPROJECT\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- lib/db.js ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' lib/db.js && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- eval files ---\\n' && find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,240p' {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && rg \"declare function revalidateTag|function revalidateTag\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && rg \"declare function unstable_cache|function unstable_cache\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- line refs ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
git status --short"
